policy: Retrieve from PMC OAI-PMH, validate exact identity, permit only CC-BY or CC0 article licenses. This is a starter supplement, not complete guideline coverage. Currency unassessed is explicit, never a current-guideline certification.

sources.rationale: EHF/EAN-endorsed 2021 consensus. CC-BY article grant includes selected tables without a separate restrictive credit line. Table 2: red flags and indications; Table 3: acute treatments and contraindications. This is dated source evidence, not authorization to prescribe or a verified current drug formulary.
WAO primary guidance; expected non-permissive license exclusion retained transparently in ingestion records.
SANJO 2023 native-joint septic arthritis guideline. Relevant to suspected joint infection and need for examination; not a universal outpatient routing policy.
WSES 2022 emergency surgery guideline for suspected acute mesenteric ischemia; disease-specific recommendations do not imply all abdominal pain has this disease.

2025 emergency medicine telehealth educational compendium. Care-delivery review, NOT a disease guideline, telehealth efficacy trial, or evidence that asynchronous care replaces a necessary physical examination.
